hero.headline: Where AI Moves from Ambition to Action
hero.description: AIX Summit 2026 is a one-day executive summit in Doha, bringing together around 110 senior enterprise leaders across six sponsored roundtables and focused stage moments designed for leaders deploying, governing, and scaling production AI.
hero.quote: AI has evolved from experimental stages to practical implementation. The current challenges involve deployment strategies, redesigning work processes, security measures, governance, and converting investments into tangible results. AIX facilitates collaboration by bringing decision-makers together across two focused 75-minute sessions.

positioning.title: A Room Designed for Real Deployment Challenges

blocks.title: No Generic Panels
blocks.desc: Stage time is reserved exclusively for unscripted, highly technical cross-examinations. The majority of the day happens off-stage.

blocks.title: Strictly Enterprise
blocks.desc: AIX is built for institutional scale. We focus on sovereign deployment, critical infrastructure, financial services, and state security.

blocks.title: Verified Case Studies
blocks.desc: Foundational models are only the starting point. We prioritize live demonstrations of applied, outcome-generating AI.

blocks.title: Closed-Door Candor
blocks.desc: Meaningful challenges cannot be discussed on a livestream. The roundtables operate strictly under the Chatham House Rule.

roundtablesIntro.title: The Six Executive Roundtables
roundtablesIntro.description: Partnership at AIX Summit provides substantive access to a curated executive room, not passive brand impressions. Six Roundtable Chair partnerships are open for organisations leading AI deployments in Qatar and the GCC.

showcaseIntro.title: Enterprise Startup Showcase
showcaseIntro.description: Six minutes to prove it works. Throughout the afternoon, twelve heavily-vetted Series A+ enterprise AI startups present live, working software directly to the roundtable executives.

roundtablesSection.footnote: Each roundtable seats 15 — a chair, up to two sponsor executives, and twelve invited guests. Conducted under Chatham House principles.

chairCard.title: Chair a Roundtable
chairCard.description: A dedicated room, 12 invited senior leaders, and strategic ownership of a key enterprise AI domain. Roundtable Chair sponsorships are the primary commercial product for 2026.

programmeSection.title: The Day at a Glance
programmeSection.sourceNote: Rows come from the Programme tab. Edit times and titles there; this section only controls the headings.

criteria.detail: Live product in production, zero mockups.
Security, data privacy, and architecture readiness.

audienceSection.title: Who is in the Room
audienceSection.description: An invited room of around 110 participants across six key stakeholder groups.

signalsSection.title: AIX Roundtable Signals
signalsSection.description: The conversations don't end at 18:00. Each table produces an anonymised synthesis — what executives are seeing, where they're investing, and what's preventing scale — published in mid-January 2027 as an institutional research report.
